description: This file defines the StreamWrapperManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing stream wrappers including registration, deregistration, and URI normalization.

classes.name: StreamWrapperManager
classes.description: Manages stream wrappers in Drupal, allowing registration, deregistration, and URI handling.

methods.name: getWrappers
methods.description: Retrieves stream wrappers filtered by type.

methods.name: getNames
methods.description: Returns the names of stream wrappers for a given filter.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns descriptions of stream wrappers for a given filter.

methods.name: getViaScheme
methods.description: Gets a stream wrapper instance via scheme.

methods.name: getViaUri
methods.description: Gets a stream wrapper instance via URI.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for a given scheme.

methods.name: getWrapper
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a stream wrapper instance for a scheme and URI.

methods.name: addStreamWrapper
methods.description: Adds a new stream wrapper configuration.

methods.name: registerWrapper
methods.description: Registers a specific stream wrapper scheme.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Extracts the target part from a URI.

methods.name: normalizeUri
methods.description: Normalizes a URI to a standard format.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Extracts the scheme from a URI.

methods.name: isValidScheme
methods.description: Checks if a scheme is valid and has an associated class.

methods.name: isValidUri
methods.description: Checks if a URI has a valid scheme.
